followups.title: Backend test failing on develop: test_rank_end_to_end::test_a_due_daily_schedule_checks_each_keyword_once_even_when_the_provider_relists_them (6 sent, expected 3)
followups.detail: Reproduced alone on a clean develop checkout inside the Colima mount; it passed in the WP-03 full run about 3 hours earlier, so it is probably clock or schedule-window dependent. The release check (ship.sh runs the whole backend suite) will hit it. Also test_five_thousand_keywords_from_a_csv_get_their_metrics_and_a_cost (cancelled under load, passes alone; see F-05). ROOT CAUSE: test opened its schedule window at now-2h UTC; between 00:00 and 02:00 UTC (05:30 to 07:30 IST) that is yesterday, so schedule and check-now runs fall on different project-local days and each keyword is legitimately planned twice. Source is correct; test now uses max(now-2h, start of today UTC).

followups.title: WEB BUG: history-model.ts sums overlapping pooled weekly points (n inflated up to 4 times)
followups.detail: apps/web/src/features/prompts/history-model.ts lines ~66-80 sums the trailing 4 weekly mentioned points of a prompt row. Under C-11 every prompt point is already a trailing 4 week pool, so summing four overlapping pools counts answers up to 4 times (n inflated, Wilson band too narrow, wrong insufficient state). Fix: read each point as it is (use its own pooled numerator and denominator, and pool.weeks/pool.window for the label); the web mock prompt-summary.ts should also pool (returns is_pooled false and no pool today). MUST be fixed before the web switches from mocks to the real API. Owner: WP-18 or WP-20 (first to touch history), or a small fix package.
followups.owner: web (assign to the next free session)
